Author: AktOn1
Name: Sphere Player
Description: Plays music from the original Final Fantasy I to XVI soundtracks (YouTube, shown in a small video window) and switches it by what you are doing in game: town, field, dungeon, battle, boss. It can mute the game's own music and take over. On first start it downloads a Chromium based player (about 160 MB).
Punchline: Town, battle and boss music from the Final Fantasies you choose.
